name: Winters Cold Embrace
body:
The erqigdlet have a strong mystical connection with snow and winter, which can permeate their magic.

Prerequisite(s): Erqigdlet

Benefit(s): When dealing fire, acid, electricity or sonic damage via a spell or class feature, the erqigdlet can opt to instead deal an equal amount of cold damage instead.
